import cv2, numpy as np

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0024.png')
# find exact corner where sofa meets floor on the right
sofa_mask = (img[:, :, 0] < 110) & (img[:, :, 0] > 70) & (img[:, :, 1] < 110) & (img[:, :, 1] > 70)
# Find max u of sofa at bottom
vs, us = np.where(sofa_mask)
print('Max u:', us.max(), 'at v:', vs[us == us.max()])
# let's look at the rightmost edge of the sofa:
for u in range(260, 275):
    v_indices = np.where(sofa_mask[:, u])[0]
    if len(v_indices) > 0:
        print(f'u={u}, min v={v_indices.min()}, max v={v_indices.max()}')
"
